purpose: GoHighLevel CRM and sub-account governance CLI with preview-first mutations, API readback, rebilling and scope audits, and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.10+. Offline doctor and governance audits (rebilling-audit, scope-audit, smtp-audit) need no credentials. Live sub-account CRM operations require GHL_PIT (or GHL_ACCESS_TOKEN) and GHL_LOCATION_ID in the process environment; writes require explicit location and preview-hash confirmation.
discovery.not_for: Ambient HighLevel/LeadConnector MCP servers, unconfirmed bulk CRM mutations, or storing tokens in plaintext profiles.
examples: Inspect my GoHighLevel pipelines, calendars, and workflows
Triage recent HighLevel contacts and conversations without pulling raw PII
Preview and update a GoHighLevel custom value with readback verification
Audit HighLevel sub-account rebilling markups, custom SMTP locks, and V2 user scopes
Attach the GoHighLevel operations knowledge library to my Empire vault

scope: Portable Python CLI for HighLevel API v2 sub-account inspection (locations, contacts, pipelines, opportunities, calendars, conversations, workflows, forms, surveys, custom fields/values), preview-first custom-value mutations with API readback, agency governance audits (rebilling 1.05x Stripe fee shield, V1/V2 user scopes, custom SMTP unlocking), and an attachable legends-empire knowledge pack.
